rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS `building key (current)`,
  fba.STREET_NUMBER,
  fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
  fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
  fba.STREET_NAME,
  fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
  fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
  CONCAT_WS(' ',
    fba.STREET_NUMBER,
    fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
    fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.STREET_NAME,
    fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
    fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL
  ) AS `street address`,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM fclt_organization fo
JOIN fclt_building fb
  ON fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN fclt_building_address fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LIMIT 1

  COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, d.MEET_PLACE, d.LOCATION_NAME, d.LOCATION) AS location,
  t.TERM_START_DATE AS term_start_date,
  MIN(p.PERSON_NAME) AS supervisor_name

  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY

  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, d.MEET_PLACE, d.LOCATION_NAME, d.LOCATION)

  tm.TITLE AS material_title,
  tm.ISBN AS isbn,
  st.subject_new_total AS total_new_material_cost
FROM tip_detail td
JOIN tip_material tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN tip_material_status tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

  ON td.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID

    SUM(tm2.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS subject_new_total

rows.question: What is the name of the building, total number of subjects, total fee, and shortest and longest sessions for each physical IAP session location?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SESSION_LOCATION, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building,
  COUNT(*) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(0) AS total_fee,
  -- shortest session in minutes
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME = '' OR s.SESSION_END_TIME = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE
        LEAST(
          GREATEST(
            (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')) - TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) / 60,
            (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')) + 24*3600 - TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) / 60
          ),
          24*60
        )
    END
  ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  -- longest session in minutes
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME = '' OR s.SESSION_END_TIME = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE
        GREATEST(
          (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')) - TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) / 60,
          (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')) + 24*3600 - TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) / 60
        )
    END
  ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM iap_subject_session s
WHERE
  -- include only physical (non-virtual/online) locations
  s.SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SESSION_LOCATION <> ''
  AND LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) NOT LIKE '%online%'
  AND LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) NOT LIKE '%virtual%'
  AND LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) NOT LIKE '%zoom%'
  -- require start/end times present and in expected format like '0900AM' (6 chars) or '1200PM'
  AND s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SESSION_START_TIME <> ''
  AND s.SESSION_END_TIME <> ''
  AND CHAR_LENGTH(s.SESSION_START_TIME) = 6
  AND CHAR_LENGTH(s.SESSION_END_TIME) = 6
  AND RIGHT(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 2) IN ('AM','PM')
  AND RIGHT(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 2) IN ('AM','PM')
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SESSION_LOCATION, ''), 'UNKNOWN')
ORDER BY total_subjects DESC

  SUM(IFNULL(d.FEE, 0)) AS total_fee,
  MIN(

      STR_TO_DATE(sess.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(sess.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
    )
  ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(sess.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(sess.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
    )
  ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM iap_subject_session sess
-- There is no iap_subject_detail table in the provided schema. Keep a safe left join placeholder for fees (all NULL)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, NULL AS FEE
) d ON sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
-- subject_iap_schedule exists and can provide SUBJECT_ID when linked by SESSION_NUMBER and IAP_DATE
LEFT JOIN subject_iap_schedule s
  ON s.SESSION_NUMBER = sess.SESSION_SEQUENCE
     AND (s.IAP_DATE = sess.SESSION_DATE OR s.IAP_DATE IS NULL OR sess.SESSION_DATE IS NULL)
-- drupal_course_catalog may have SECTION_ID matching SESSION_LOCATION to represent a subject/course
LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog i

WHERE (
      LOWER(IFNULL(sess.SESSION_LOCATION, '')) LIKE '%virtual%'

  -- restrict to IAP sessions: SESSION_DATE present (IAP sessions are in this table) and/or term indicator 'IAP' where available
  AND (

       FROM drupal_course_catalog dc
       WHERE dc.SECTION_ID = sess.SESSION_LOCATION
         AND (LOWER(IFNULL(dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, '')) = 'iap' OR LOWER(IFNULL(dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, '')) = 'iap')
     )
  )

  FROM hr_org_unit_new

ss_subjects AS (
  -- subject_selector has school/department mapping
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SCHOOL_CODE,'') AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    COALESCE(SCHOOL_NAME,'') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE,'') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME,'') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM subject_selector
  WHERE SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL OR DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(SCHOOL_CODE,''), COALESCE(SCHOOL_NAME,''), COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE,''), COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')
),
dept_phone_counts AS (
  -- count phone number entries per department from sis_admin_department
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE,'') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS phone_count
  FROM sis_admin_department
  WHERE (DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) <> '')
     OR (DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE) <> '')
  GROUP BY COALESCE(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE,'')
),
-- Aggregate course levels from drupal_course_catalog and sis_course_description to determine most common per department.
dept_course_levels AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(u_cnt) AS u_cnt,
    SUM(g_cnt) AS g_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE,'') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      SUM(CASE WHEN COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u_cnt,
      SUM(CASE WHEN COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS g_cnt
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE COURSE_LEVEL IN ('U','G')
    GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE,'')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      COALESCE(DEPARTMENT,'') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      SUM(CASE WHEN COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u_cnt,
      SUM(CASE WHEN COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS g_cnt
    FROM sis_course_description
    WHERE COURSE_LEVEL IN ('U','G')
    GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT,'')
  ) t
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
dept_most_common AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(g_cnt,0) > COALESCE(u_cnt,0) THEN 'G'
      WHEN COALESCE(u_cnt,0) > COALESCE(g_cnt,0) THEN 'U'
      WHEN COALESCE(g_cnt,0) = COALESCE(u_cnt,0) AND COALESCE(g_cnt,0) > 0 THEN 'G'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS most_common_course_level
  FROM dept_course_levels
),
-- Start with all distinct departments that appear in any of our sources to ensure coverage
all_departments AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM sis_courses
  UNION
  SELECT COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE,'') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME,'') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM hr_schools
  UNION
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ss_subjects
)
SELECT

  COALESCE(h.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  COALESCE(dp.phone_count, 0) AS total_phone_numbers,
  COALESCE(dm.most_common_course_level, 'U') AS most_common_course_level

LEFT JOIN hr_schools h ON h.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN ss_subjects ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_phone_counts dp ON dp.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_most_common dm ON dm.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY SCHOOL_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE

    NULL AS dlc_key,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(`GRADUATE_LEVEL`, NULL), '') AS graduate_level,

    COALESCE(CAST(`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS CHAR), `SUBJECT_CODE`, '') AS subject_number_or_code,
    COALESCE(`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, '') AS dept_for_count

rows.question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?

WITH current_term AS (
  SELECT
    `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM academic_terms_all
  WHERE `IS_CURRENT_TERM` = 'Y'
),
offered AS (
  SELECT
    so.`TERM_CODE`,
    so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    so.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    so.`HGN_CODE`,
    -- prefer catalog units, else summary units
    COALESCE(ccso.`TOTAL_UNITS`, sos.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN current_term ct ON so.`TERM_CODE` = ct.`TERM_CODE`
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
    ON ccso.`TERM_CODE` = so.`TERM_CODE`
    AND ccso.`SUBJECT_ID` = so.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
    ON sos.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` = so.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`
  WHERE so.`HGN_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND so.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
dept AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
  FROM student_department
)
SELECT
  ct.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  ct.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  off.`HGN_CODE` AS `HGN_CODE`,
  -- count distinct course type values per course offering.
  -- Use MASTER_SUBJECT_ID and SUBJECT_ID to represent course type distinctions.
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(IFNULL(off.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,''), '||', IFNULL(off.`SUBJECT_ID`,''))) AS `NUM_COURSE_TYPES`,
  -- average of unit values for the offering; ignore NULL/empty
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(off.`TOTAL_UNITS`, '') AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) AS `AVG_TOTAL_UNITS`,
  COALESCE(d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, off.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  CASE
    WHEN off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`) <> ''
      THEN CONCAT(TRIM(off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`), '@mit.edu')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL`,
  off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
FROM current_term ct
JOIN offered off ON off.`TERM_CODE` = ct.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN dept d ON d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = off.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`
-- ensure academic year, term code, and hgn code are present per requirements
WHERE ct.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` IS NOT NULL
  AND ct.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  AND off.`HGN_CODE` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ct.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  ct.`TERM_CODE`,
  off.`HGN_CODE`,
  COALESCE(d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, off.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`),
  off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  off.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
ORDER BY ct.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` DESC, ct.`TERM_CODE`, off.`HGN_CODE`

rows.question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.

WITH chunk_view_0 AS (

  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  -- include building-level square footage columns (to be aggregated later if needed)
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER,
  b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM buildings b
WHERE b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
chunk_view_1 AS (
SELECT
  FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  DATE_BUILT,
  EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  -- include HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME from employee_directory which links via OFFICE_LOCATION to building number; keep join keys for later
  -- include NUM_OF_ROOMS in case "unit" refers to rooms; keep other building identifiers for joins
  NUM_OF_ROOMS,
  BUILDING_NUMBER,
  COST_COLLECTOR_KEY,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_building
WHERE FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
chunk_view_2 AS (
SELECT
  FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_ROOM AS BUILDING_NAME,
  FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  ORGANIZATION_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  AREA AS ASSIGNABLE_SQFT,
  ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  FLOOR,
  LATITUDE_WGS,
  LONGITUDE_WGS,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fclt_rooms
WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME SEPARATOR ', ')
     FROM fclt_rooms r
     JOIN fac_organization fo ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
     JOIN hr_org_unit_new h ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
     WHERE r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
       AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
    ),
    ''
  ) AS HR_DEPARTMENTS,
  SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  SUM(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  AVG(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS AVERAGE_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  CASE
    WHEN b.DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR b.DATE_BUILT = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
  END AS BUILT_YEAR
FROM fclt_building_hist_1 b
GROUP BY
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  CASE
    WHEN b.DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR b.DATE_BUILT = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
  END
